runtime: Python 3.10+ standard library; no installation, network, live accounts, or model execution required for local checks
word_count_rule: len(decoded_utf8_text.split()); includes headings, numbers, and references
semantic_review: Independent blinded source-grounded review required. Synthetic review controls test scoring wiring, not semantic evaluator validity.
blinding: Provide the ../../cases/F4 packet only to task runners; reviewers receive rubric and an anonymized submission with random submission label, not treatment identity, reference/control identity, or synthetic review.
time_limit_clock: Starts at runner process launch, includes skill reading and self-checks, excludes setup and grading. Predeclared in the pilot protocol.
